arXiv:2609.08673v1 [cs.RO] 2026 年 9 月 8 日arXiv:2609.08673v1 [cs.RO] 08 Sep 2026

BIFTA：针对未知传感器的受大脑启发的少量触觉适应BIFTA: Brain-Inspired Few-Shot Tactile Adaptation for Unknown Sensors

Boheng Liu Affiliation: School of Computer Science and Technology Affiliation: Beijing Institute of Technology Affiliation: Beijing, China Email: boheng@bit.edu.cn    Ziyu Li ††thanks: Corresponding author. Affiliation: School of Computer Science and Technology Affiliation: Beijing Institute of Technology Affiliation: Beijing, China Email: ziyuli@bit.edu.cn    Xia Wu Affiliation: School of Computer Science and Technology Affiliation: Beijing Institute of Technology Affiliation: Beijing, China
摘要Abstract

触觉传感的进步使丰富的接触感知成为可能，加速了机器人操作、材料理解和具体交互的进展。然而，由于触觉传感器的光学设计、弹性体力学和成像几何形状存在很大差异，因此在已知传感器类型上训练的模型可能会在未知传感器上遭受突然的性能崩溃。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 Brain-Inspired Few-Shot Tactile Adaptation (BIFTA) 框架；它利用大脑的快速感觉适应机制，使冻结的编码器适应来自小型标记支持集的未知触觉传感器。 BIFTA 通过双视图统计内存保留预训练的表示，构建支持条件谱图来修复依赖于传感器的特征邻域，并应用不确定性门控循环传播来加强可靠的交叉查询证据。跨三个触觉数据集的广泛基准测试表明，BIFTA 显着提高了对未知传感器的适应能力：SITR 上仅标记了 10% 的目标数据，它将平均 Sparsh 准确度从冻结源分类器的 6.86% 提高到 87.09%，比先前实现的最强比较高出 47.22 个百分点，并且这些收益适用于数据集、预训练骨干网和触觉任务。这些结果验证了 BIFTA 对未知触觉传感器的数据高效适应，并为跨异构硬件传输的触觉模型提供了一条有前途的途径。Advances in tactile sensing have made contact-rich perception possible, accelerating progress in robotic manipulation, material understanding, and embodied interaction. However, because optical design, elastomer mechanics, and imaging geometry differ substantially across tactile sensors, models trained on known sensor types can suffer an abrupt performance collapse on unknown sensors. To address this problem, we propose the Brain-Inspired Few-Shot Tactile Adaptation (BIFTA) framework; it draws on the brain’s rapid sensory adaptation mechanism to adapt a frozen encoder to an unknown tactile sensor from a small labeled support set. BIFTA preserves pretrained representations through dual-view statistical memory, constructs support-conditioned spectral graphs to repair sensor-dependent feature neighborhoods, and applies uncertainty-gated recurrent propagation to strengthen reliable cross-query evidence. Extensive benchmarks across three tactile datasets show that BIFTA substantially improves adaptation to unknown sensors: with only 10% labeled target data on SITR, it raises mean Sparsh accuracy from 6.86% for the frozen source classifier to 87.09%, exceeding the strongest implemented prior comparison by 47.22 percentage points, and these gains generalize across datasets, pretrained backbones, and tactile tasks. These results validate BIFTA for data-efficient adaptation to unknown tactile sensors and offer a promising route toward tactile models that transfer across heterogeneous hardware.

   

预印本Preprint

1 简介Introduction

随着具身智能的快速进步，触摸正在成为必须通过接触感知和理解物理世界的智能体的核心能力。基于视觉的触觉传感器可以恢复外部视觉无法直接观察到的接触几何形状和材料响应，从而使机器人感知更接近人类触摸，并改善操作、物体识别和物理交互With rapid progress in embodied intelligence, touch is becoming a core capability for agents that must perceive and understand the physical world through contact. Vision-based tactile sensors recover contact geometry and material responses that external vision cannot directly observe, thereby bringing robotic perception closer to human touch and improving manipulation, object recognition, and physical interaction(Yuan et al., 2017; Lambeta et al., 2020)。然而，光学、标记布局、视野和弹性体力学的差异导致相同的接触产生特定于传感器的观察结果。大多数触觉模型都会在一种或多种已知传感器类型上大规模学习表示，并且在与以前未见过的硬件一起部署时泛化能力很差。因此，快速适应未知的触觉传感器对于传感器更换、硬件升级和异构机器人队列至关重要。. However, differences in optics, marker layout, field of view, and elastomer mechanics cause the same contact to produce sensor-specific observations. Most tactile models learn representations at scale on one or several known sensor types and generalize poorly when deployed with previously unseen hardware. Rapid adaptation to unknown tactile sensors is therefore essential for sensor replacement, hardware upgrades, and heterogeneous robot fleets.

最近的触觉基础模型降低了学习可转移特征的成本。 TVL 将触摸与视觉和语言结合起来，以学习基于语义的触觉表示，而 Sparsh 使用异构触觉数据的自我监督学习来支持跨下游任务的传输Recent tactile foundation models reduce the cost of learning transferable features. TVL aligns touch with vision and language to learn semantically grounded tactile representations, while Sparsh uses self-supervised learning on heterogeneous tactile data to support transfer across downstream tasks(Fu et al., 2024; Higuera et al., 2025a)。跨传感器方法进一步学习不变性、对齐或传感器条件表示. Cross-sensor methods further learn invariance, alignment, or sensor-conditioned representations(Gupta et al., 2025; Feng et al., 2025; Zhang et al., 2026)。然而，这些模型是从一组有限的传感器设计中学习的，无法预测部署后遇到的每个设备。数字. Nevertheless, these models learn from a finite set of sensor designs and cannot anticipate every device encountered after deployment. Figure1显示结果：在其源传感器上表现良好的 TVL 分类器在每个评估的未知传感器上都接近机会。在新设备上进行微调或额外的表示学习可以缩小这种差距，但它需要目标数据、计算和优化，而有限的监督可能会覆盖可重用的功能或适应特定于传感器的工件。更根本的是，传感器移位可以放大无差别的特征方向，改变最近邻关系，并使不同的编码器读数不一致，从而使预训练的几何形状与目标传感器的匹配不佳。shows the consequence: a TVL classifier that performs well on its source sensor falls close to chance on every evaluated unknown sensor. Fine-tuning or additional representation learning on the new device can reduce this gap, but it requires target data, computation, and optimization, while limited supervision can overwrite reusable features or fit sensor-specific artifacts. More fundamentally, sensor shift can amplify nondiscriminative feature directions, alter nearest-neighbor relations, and make different encoder readouts disagree, leaving the pretrained geometry poorly matched to the target sensor.

少样本适应提供了两条实用的途径。基于优化的方法附加一个轻量级分类器或适配器，并从标记的支持集更新它；这直接调整了目标决策边界，但它仍然需要训练并且可能会过度拟合稀缺的示例。基于关系的方法通过原型、标准化最近邻、支持缓存或查询图进行分类Few-shot adaptation offers two practical routes. Optimization-based approaches attach a lightweight classifier or adapter and update it from the labeled support set; this directly adjusts the target decision boundary, but it still requires training and can overfit scarce examples. Relation-based approaches instead classify through prototypes, normalized nearest neighbors, support caches, or query graphs(Wang et al., 2019; Zhang et al., 2022; Ziko et al., 2020; Boudiaf et al., 2020)。它们降低了优化成本并可以利用查询结构，但它们的成功取决于传感器转移后仍然有意义的特征指标。扭曲的邻域可能会使图推理传播相关错误，而均匀传播则使可靠和不可靠的查询对其邻域具有相同的依赖性。这些方法降低了适应成本，但它们不能共同保留稳定的预训练证据、修复特定于目标的几何形状以及控制每个查询的关系推理。这暴露了我们工作的核心问题：. They reduce optimization cost and can exploit query structure, but their success depends on a feature metric that remains meaningful after sensor shift. Distorted neighborhoods can make graph inference propagate correlated errors, while uniform propagation gives reliable and unreliable queries the same dependence on their neighbors. These approaches reduce adaptation cost, yet they do not jointly preserve stable pretrained evidence, repair target-specific geometry, and control relational inference for each query. This exposes the central question of our work:触觉基础模型如何仅使用几个标记的接触点，并在此过程中将其感知能力快速可靠地传输到未知传感器？how can a tactile foundation model use only a few labeled contacts and, in doing so, transfer its perception capability rapidly and reliably to an unknown sensor?

为了解决这个问题，我们从大脑的快速感觉适应机制中汲取灵感To address this question, we draw inspiration from the brain’s rapid sensory adaptation mechanism(McClelland et al., 1995; Carandini and Heeger, 2012; Ernst and Banks, 2002; Khona and Fiete, 2022)并提出大脑启发的少样本触觉适应（BIFTA）。首先，and propose Brain-Inspired Few-Shot Tactile Adaptation (BIFTA). First,快速支持记忆rapid support memory将判别记忆与来自同一冻结编码器的两个读数相匹配；然后它将它们融合成一个稳定的概率锚。第二，fits discriminant memories to two readouts from the same frozen encoder; it then fuses them into a stable probability anchor. Second,支持条件光谱几何support-conditioned spectral geometry使用标记的目标变化来抑制不稳定的特征方向；然后，它构建一个具有更可靠邻域的交叉读出共识图。三、uses labeled target variation to suppress unstable feature directions; it then constructs a cross-readout consensus graph with more reliable neighborhoods. Third,可靠性门控锚定复发reliability-gated anchored recurrence使用预测模糊性和读出分歧；这些信号决定每个查询在保留其源自支持的锚的同时应吸收图形证据的强度。通过将稳定存储器与快速几何重新校准和可靠性控制集成分开，BIFTA 将未知传感器传输转换为支持条件推理问题，无需基于梯度的编码器更新，从而弥合了预训练传感器体验与以前未见过的硬件之间的差距。uses prediction ambiguity and readout disagreement; these signals determine how strongly each query should absorb graph evidence while retaining its support-derived anchor. By separating stable memory from rapid geometric recalibration and reliability-controlled integration, BIFTA converts unknown-sensor transfer into a support-conditioned inference problem without gradient-based encoder updates, bridging the gap between pretrained sensor experience and previously unseen hardware.

使用两个冻结骨干网对三个触觉数据集进行的实验表明，BIFTA 显着改善了对未知传感器的感知。在 SITR 上仅标记 10% 的目标数据的情况下，BIFTA 将 TVL 准确率从冻结源分类器的 7.58% 提高到 85.71%，比最强的外部比较高出 38.24 个百分点。在 TacVerse Shape 上，相同的目标数据预算将 Sparsh 准确率从 13.67% 提高到 83.58%，比最强的外部比较高出 27.60 个百分点。收益延伸到数据集、预训练主干以及触觉分类和检索任务。这些结果表明，受大脑启发的快速适应可以增强跨传感器触觉泛化，从而为不断发展的硬件中的鲁棒体现感知提供了一个有前途的方向。Experiments across three tactile datasets, using two frozen backbones, demonstrate that BIFTA substantially improves perception on unknown sensors. With only 10% labeled target data on SITR, BIFTA raises TVL accuracy from the frozen source classifier’s 7.58% to 85.71% and exceeds the strongest external comparison by 38.24 percentage points. On TacVerse Shape, the same target-data budget raises Sparsh accuracy from 13.67% to 83.58%, exceeding the strongest external comparison by 27.60 points. The gains extend across datasets, pretrained backbones, and tactile classification and retrieval tasks. These results show that brain-inspired rapid adaptation can strengthen cross-sensor tactile generalization, thereby offering a promising direction for robust embodied perception across evolving hardware.

2 相关工作Related Work

触觉基础模型。Tactile foundation models.基于视觉的触觉学习始于 GelSight 和 DIGIT 等传感器，它们将接触变形转换为高分辨率图像Vision-based tactile learning began with sensors such as GelSight and DIGIT, which convert contact deformation into high-resolution images(Yuan et al., 2017; Lambeta et al., 2020)。早期的大规模资源（例如 Touch and Go）支持视觉-触觉配对学习. Early large-scale resources such as Touch and Go enabled paired vision–touch learning(Yang et al., 2022)。然后，触觉基础模型从特定于任务的监督转向可重用的多模式和自我监督表示。 TVL 将触摸与视觉和语言结合起来，UniTouch 通过传感器特定的令牌绑定异构传感器，ViT-Lens 将触摸连接到预先训练的视觉表示，Sparsh 从未标记的触觉数据中学习可转移的特征. Tactile foundation models then moved from task-specific supervision toward reusable multimodal and self-supervised representations. TVL aligns touch with vision and language, UniTouch binds heterogeneous sensors through sensor-specific tokens, ViT-Lens connects touch to a pretrained visual representation, and Sparsh learns transferable features from unlabeled tactile data(Fu et al., 2024; Yang et al., 2024; Lei et al., 2024; Higuera et al., 2025a)。最近的模型进一步将触觉学习扩展到多感官操纵、分布式触觉皮肤和视觉触觉材料定位. Recent models have further expanded tactile learning toward multisensory manipulation, distributed tactile skin, and visual–tactile material localization(Higuera et al., 2025b; Sharma et al., 2025; Kim et al., 2026)。这些进步增加了数据规模、语义对齐和硬件多样性，但学习的编码器仍然仅限于来自有限传感器集的数据。未知传感器上的光学配置、标记布局和弹性体力学的变化会改变特征统计数据和邻域结构，从而导致高效适应变得困难。. These advances increase data scale, semantic alignment, and hardware diversity, but the learned encoders remain limited to data from a finite set of sensors. Changes in optical configuration, marker layout, and elastomer mechanics on an unknown sensor alter feature statistics and neighborhood structure, making efficient adaptation difficult.

未知触觉传感器的小样本学习。Few-shot learning for unknown tactile sensors.一般的小样本学习方法广泛遵循基于优化或基于关系的策略。基于优化的方法适合支持集中的轻量级分类器、适配器或测试时状态，可以直接调整决策边界，但需要迭代更新，并且可能会过度拟合稀缺的示例General few-shot learning methods broadly follow optimization-based or relation-based strategies. Optimization-based methods fit a lightweight classifier, adapter, or test-time state from the support set, which can adjust the decision boundary directly but requires iterative updates and can overfit scarce examples(Karmanov et al., 2024; Boudiaf et al., 2020; Singh et al., 2026)。基于关系的方法保留冻结的特征，并通过标准化原型、支持缓存、概率目标或查询图进行分类. Relation-based methods retain frozen features and classify through normalized prototypes, support caches, probability objectives, or query graphs(Wang et al., 2019; Zhang et al., 2022; Ziko et al., 2020; Zhou et al., 2003; Martin et al., 2024)。这些方法降低了目标训练成本，但固定度量或不可靠的伪标签可能会放大传感器移位后的误差。专门为触觉硬件设计的小镜头适应仍然很少。最接近的跨传感器方法使用 SITR 中的模拟变化和校准、AnyTouch 中的跨传感器匹配或 CTSRL 中的合成传输和传感器调节调制. These methods reduce target-training cost, but a fixed metric or unreliable pseudo-label can amplify errors after sensor shift. Few-shot adaptation designed specifically for tactile hardware remains sparse. The closest cross-sensor methods use simulated variation and calibration in SITR, cross-sensor matching in AnyTouch, or synthetic transfer and sensor-conditioned modulation in CTSRL(Gupta et al., 2025; Feng et al., 2025; Zhang et al., 2026)。这些方法需要特定的校准或配对数据，或者当未知传感器与训练传感器有很大不同时很难适应。它们还在整体传感器或表示级别上进行调整，导致类相关的特征失真和不可靠的查询关系没有得到充分解决。相反，BIFTA 从小型标记支持集中学习目标统计数据，使用它们来重塑邻域几何形状并调节证据传播，而无需配对校准观察或编码器重新训练。. These approaches require specific calibration or paired data, or struggle to adapt when an unknown sensor differs substantially from the training sensors. They also adapt at the overall sensor or representation level, leaving class-dependent feature distortion and unreliable query relations insufficiently addressed. BIFTA instead learns target statistics from a small labeled support set, using them to reshape neighborhood geometry and regulate evidence propagation without paired calibration observations or encoder retraining.

3.2 类脑设计概述Brain-inspired design overview

人类的感知在不断变化的感官条件下保持稳定，因为大脑将长期知识与快速感官适应结合起来。补充学习保护既定的表征，同时融入新的经验，感觉标准化重新校准对当前输入统计数据的响应，可靠性加权循环积分积累不确定的证据以获得稳定的解释Human perception remains stable under changing sensory conditions, as the brain combines long-term knowledge with rapid sensory adaptation. Complementary learning protects established representations while incorporating new experience, sensory normalization recalibrates responses to current input statistics, and reliability-weighted recurrent integration accumulates uncertain evidence toward a stable interpretation(McClelland et al., 1995; Carandini and Heeger, 2012; Ernst and Banks, 2002; Khona and Fiete, 2022)。这些过程共同使得感知能够快速调整，而不会丢弃以前获得的知识。. Together, these processes allow perception to adjust quickly without discarding previously acquired knowledge.

受这一机制的启发，BIFTA耦合了三个模块，如图Inspired by this mechanism, BIFTA couples three modules, as shown in Figure2. 快速支持记忆Rapid support memory将两个冻结读数转换为支持监督的概率锚converts the two frozen readouts into a support-supervised probability anchorP0∈[0,1]m×CP_{0}\in[0,1]^{m\times C}。一个. A支持条件谱图support-conditioned spectral graph抑制不稳定的特征方向并生成查询亲和度矩阵suppresses unstable feature directions and produces a query affinity matrixG∈ℝ+m×mG\in\mathbb{R}_{+}^{m\times m}, 其中, whereℝ+\mathbb{R}_{+}表示非负实数。一个denotes the nonnegative real numbers. A查询方式的可靠性门query-wise reliability gate形成对角矩阵forms a diagonal matrixR∈[0,1]m×mR\in[0,1]^{m\times m}它控制每个查询使用关系证据的强度。他们的联合行动保留了稳定的类别证据，同时重新校准未知传感器的依赖于传感器的几何形状和证据流。that controls how strongly each query uses relational evidence. Their joint action preserves stable class evidence while recalibrating sensor-dependent geometry and evidence flow for the unknown sensor.

4 实验Experiments

4.1 实验装置Experimental setup

数据集和标签预算。Datasets and label budgets.

SITR (Gupta et al., 2025)包含七个传感器和一个 16 类子集。我们使用 DIGIT 作为源，使用四个 GelSight Mini 设备、GelSight Hex 和 GelSight Wedge 作为六个目标；所有 6 个传感器均不在 TVL 的 DIGIT 预训练范围内，而 Hex 和 Wedge 不在 Sparsh 预训练列出的传感器系列范围内。从每个类和目标的 800 个训练图像中，1%、5% 和 10% 的预算提供 8、40 和 80 个支持图像，200 个图像评估分割为每个目标提供 3,200 个查询。 TacVerse 形状contains seven sensors and a 16-class subset. We use DIGIT as the source and four GelSight Mini devices, GelSight Hex, and GelSight Wedge as six targets; all six are outside TVL’s DIGIT pretraining, while Hex and Wedge are outside the sensor families listed for Sparsh pretraining. From the 800 training images per class and target, 1%, 5%, and 10% budgets provide 8, 40, and 80 support images, and the 200-image evaluation split gives 3,200 queries per target. TacVerse Shape(Wei et al., 2026)包含七个传感器和九个形状类别。我们使用 GelSightNoMarker 作为源，MagicGripper、MagicTac、TacTip、ViTac 和 ViTacTip 作为五个目标，所有这些都没有出现在两个骨干网列出的预训练传感器中。每个传感器类对分为 300 个训练图像、100 个验证图像和 100 个测试图像；这三个预算对每个类别 3、15 和 30 个支持图像进行采样，并为每个目标使用 900 个测试查询。战术四人组contains seven sensors and nine shape classes. We use GelSightNoMarker as the source and MagicGripper, MagicTac, TacTip, ViTac, and ViTacTip as five targets, all absent from the listed pretraining sensors of both backbones. Each sensor–class pair is divided into 300 training, 100 validation, and 100 test images; the three budgets sample 3, 15, and 30 support images per class and use 900 test queries per target. TacQuad(Feng et al., 2025)包含跨三个 RGB 传感器的 56 个注册身份。 DIGIT 是源，而 GelSight Mini 和 DuraGel 是两个目标；两者都不在 TVL 的预训练传感器之外，而 DuraGel 也不在 Sparsh 的训练传感器之外。我们对每个身份采样 2、4 或 6 个支持帧，对应于每个 20 帧序列的 10%、20% 和 30%，保留接下来的 4 帧作为时间间隙，并使用最后 4 帧形成每个目标 224 个查询。附录contains 56 enrolled identities across three RGB sensors. DIGIT is the source, while GelSight Mini and DuraGel are two targets; both are outside TVL’s pretraining sensors, and DuraGel is outside Sparsh’s. We sample 2, 4, or 6 support frames per identity, corresponding to 10%, 20%, and 30% of each 20-frame sequence, reserve the next four frames as a temporal gap, and use the final four frames to form 224 queries per target. AppendixA.2提供准确的分割和样本核算。provides the exact splits and sample accounting.

编码器和传感器暴露。Encoders and sensor exposure.

TVL ViT-Small 和 Sparsh-DINO Small 均保持冻结状态Both TVL ViT-Small and Sparsh-DINO Small remain frozen(Fu et al., 2024; Higuera et al., 2025a)。他们的架构遵循 Vision Transformer. Their architectures follow the Vision Transformer(Dosovitskiy et al., 2021)，Sparsh 使用 DINO 自蒸馏, and Sparsh uses DINO self-distillation(Caron et al., 2021)。 TVL 需要. TVL takes224×224224\times 224RGB 图像，而 Sparsh 沿通道维度连接两个 RGB 帧。 SITR 和 TacVerse 为 Sparsh 复制相同的帧，而 TacQuad 将每个帧与同一试验中较早的相邻帧配对。 TVL 使用 DIGIT 进行预训练； Sparsh 的预训练包括 DIGIT、GelSight 2017 和 GelSight Mini。附录RGB images, whereas Sparsh concatenates two RGB frames along the channel dimension. SITR and TacVerse duplicate the same frame for Sparsh, while TacQuad pairs each frame with an earlier neighboring frame from the same trial. TVL was pretrained with DIGIT; Sparsh’s pretraining includes DIGIT, GelSight 2017, and GelSight Mini. AppendixA.3细节预处理。details preprocessing.

比较方法。Comparison methods.

我们使用尖端适配器We use Tip-Adapter(Zhang et al., 2022), 简单拍摄, SimpleShot(Wang et al., 2019)，和拉普拉斯射击, and LaplacianShot(Ziko et al., 2020)作为代表性的冻结特征少样本方法。它们通过缓存关联、规范化类原型或转导查询关系传输支持信息，而无需更新触觉编码器。我们进一步包括三种最近的触觉跨传感器适应方法：SITR-Calibas representative frozen-feature few-shot methods. They transfer support information through cache affinity, normalized class prototypes, or transductive query relations without updating the tactile encoder. We further include three recent tactile cross-sensor adaptation methods: SITR-Calib(Gupta et al., 2025), AnyTouch 匹配, AnyTouch Match(Feng et al., 2025)和 CTSRL CSM, and CTSRL CSM(Zhang et al., 2026)。这些方法保留冻结特征，同时训练轻量级特征模块和分类头。附录. These methods retain frozen features while training a lightweight feature module and classification head. AppendixA.4给出了他们的实现。gives their implementations.

指标和实验设置。Metrics and experimental settings.

分类使用准确度和宏 F1Classification uses accuracy and macro-F1(Sokolova and Lapalme, 2009);排名使用平均倒数排名 (MRR); ranking uses mean reciprocal rank (MRR)(Craswell, 2009)并按照标准排名检索评估，召回率为 1 (R@1)and recall at one (R@1), following standard ranked-retrieval evaluation(Manning et al., 2008)。我们报告三个随机种子的平均值和样本标准差。所有实验都在具有 80 GB 内存的 NVIDIA H800 GPU 上运行。附录. We report the mean and sample standard deviation over three random seeds. All experiments run on an NVIDIA H800 GPU with 80 GB memory. 4.2 跨传感器分类Cross-sensor classification

表Table1表明 BIFTA 提高了 SITR 上每个主干预算设置下的未知传感器性能。在 TVL 和仅 1% 标记目标数据的情况下，BIFTA 将冻结源分类器的准确率从 7.58% 提高到 62.22%，比最强比较高出 23.67 个百分点。在 10% 预算下，准确率从 7.58% 提高到 85.71%，比最强比较高出 38.24 个百分点。使用 Sparsh，BIFTA 在三个预算下达到 62.12%、83.81% 和 87.09%，分别比 LaplacianShot 好 29.34、43.87 和 47.22 个百分点。这些结果表明，BIFTA 恢复了对未知传感器的判别能力，减少了适应所需的目标数据量，并增强了对传感器变化的鲁棒性。shows that BIFTA improves unknown-sensor performance at every backbone–budget setting on SITR. With TVL and only 1% labeled target data, BIFTA raises accuracy from 7.58% for the frozen source classifier to 62.22%, outperforming the strongest comparison by 23.67 percentage points. At the 10% budget, it raises accuracy from 7.58% to 85.71% and exceeds the strongest comparison by 38.24 percentage points. With Sparsh, BIFTA reaches 62.12%, 83.81%, and 87.09% at the three budgets, outperforming LaplacianShot by 29.34, 43.87, and 47.22 percentage points, respectively. These results show that BIFTA restores discriminative capability on unknown sensors, reduces the amount of target data required for adaptation, and strengthens robustness to sensor shifts.

表Table2评估 BIFTA 的性能优势是否转移到另一个数据集。在 TVL 为 10% 预算的情况下，BIFTA 的准确率达到 79.13%，比最强的比较高出 22.46 个百分点。借助 Sparsh，BIFTA 达到了 83.58%，比最强的比较提高了 27.60 个百分点。即使在 1% 的预算下，即每个类别仅提供三个支撑框架，BIFTA 与 TVL 相比，比最强的比较提高了 13.36 个百分点，与 Sparsh 相比也提高了 13.05 个百分点。这些结果表明，BIFTA 可以在数据集上稳健地泛化，并通过不同的预训练主干改善未知传感器识别。evaluates whether BIFTA’s performance advantage transfers to another dataset. With TVL at the 10% budget, BIFTA reaches 79.13% accuracy and outperforms the strongest comparison by 22.46 percentage points. With Sparsh, BIFTA achieves 83.58% and improves over the strongest comparison by 27.60 percentage points. Even at the 1% budget, where only three support frames are available per class, BIFTA improves over the strongest comparisons by 13.36 percentage points with TVL and 13.05 percentage points with Sparsh. These results demonstrate that BIFTA robustly generalizes across datasets and improves unknown-sensor recognition with different pretrained backbones.

图Figure3报告称，BIFTA 的增益超过了 SITR 和 TacVerse 上每个未知传感器与两个预训练骨干网络的最强比较。 SITR 中的 GelSight Hex 和 TacVerse 中的 MagicTac 涨幅最大，分别达到 55.6 和 41.6 个百分点。这种模式与 BIFTA 的双视图目标记忆保留类别证据一致，同时其支持条件谱图抑制了传感器相关方向并在明显的传感器偏移下重建类别一致的邻域。 TacVerse 中 TacTip 和 MagicGripper 的相对增益较小，随着更多目标示例的出现，增益通常会扩大，这表明在最极端的几次传感器偏移下增强适应的进一步潜力。附录中报告了其他传感器方面、类别方面和宏观 F1 结果reports BIFTA’s gain over the strongest comparison for every unknown sensor on SITR and TacVerse with both pretrained backbones. The largest gains occur on GelSight Hex in SITR and MagicTac in TacVerse, reaching 55.6 and 41.6 percentage points, respectively. This pattern is consistent with BIFTA’s dual-view target memory preserving class evidence while its support-conditioned spectral graph suppresses sensor-dependent directions and reconstructs class-consistent neighborhoods under pronounced sensor shifts. Relative gains are smaller on TacTip and MagicGripper in TacVerse, the gains generally expand as more target examples become available, indicating further potential to strengthen adaptation under the most extreme few-shot sensor shifts. Additional sensor-wise, class-wise, and macro-F1 results are reported in AppendixB.

4.3 闭集身份排名Closed-set identity ranking

表Table3报告具有不同预训练主干的 TacQuad 上的封闭集身份排名性能。使用 TVL 主干网，BIFTA 比冻结主干网的 MRR 平均提高了 64.25 个百分点，比最强的比较平均提高了 8.45 个百分点。使用 Sparsh，在支持预算为 10%、20% 和 30% 的情况下，BIFTA 的表现分别比最强的外部比较高 7.55、12.89 和 14.86 个百分点。这些结果证明了 BIFTA 的跨任务收益，验证了该框架超越分类的适应性。附录reports closed-set identity-ranking performance on TacQuad with different pretrained backbones. Using the TVL backbone, BIFTA improves MRR over the frozen backbone by an average of 64.25 percentage points and over the strongest comparison by an average of 8.45 percentage points. Using Sparsh, BIFTA outperforms the strongest external comparison by 7.55, 12.89, and 14.86 percentage points at the 10%, 20%, and 30% support budgets, respectively. These results demonstrate BIFTA’s cross-task gains, validating the framework’s adaptability beyond classification. AppendixC报告额外的 R@1 结果。reports additional R@1 results.

4.4 消融研究Ablation Study

表Table4报告 SITR 上的组件消融。在顺序组件添加中，共识重复产生的收益最大，在六个骨干预算设置中将准确性提高了 2.65-4.71 个百分点。通过在查询图上反复聚合跨视图一致的证据，它增强了邻里一致性和阶级歧视。在完整模型中，删除光谱归一化会导致最大的性能损失，准确度平均降低 5.36 个百分点，最高可达 7.06 个百分点。其支持条件协方差变换抑制传感器相关的变化，并将目标邻域与类结构对齐，使其成为稳健的跨传感器传播的核心。仅视图 1 和仅视图 2 配置也显示出相对于完整 BIFTA 的明显下降，这表明互补的分层表示保留了更丰富的类别证据并稳定了少数样本适应。这些组件共同提供互补的功能，并且它们的集成在评估的设置中实现了最强的整体性能。附录reports the component ablations on SITR. Among the sequential component additions, consensus recurrence produces the largest gain, improving accuracy by 2.65–4.71 percentage points across the six backbone–budget settings. By repeatedly aggregating cross-view-consistent evidence over the query graph, it strengthens neighborhood coherence and class discrimination. Within the full model, removing spectral normalization causes the largest performance loss, reducing accuracy by 5.36 percentage points on average and by up to 7.06 points. Its support-conditioned covariance transformation suppresses sensor-dependent variation and aligns target neighborhoods with class structure, making it central to robust cross-sensor propagation. The view-1-only and view-2-only configurations also show a clear decline relative to full BIFTA, indicating that complementary hierarchical representations preserve richer class evidence and stabilize few-shot adaptation. Together, these components provide complementary functions, and their integration achieves the strongest overall performance across the evaluated settings. AppendixD报告了额外的宏观 F1 消融，而附录reports additional macro-F1 ablations, while AppendixE介绍了参数敏感性实验。presents the parameter-sensitivity experiments.

5 结论Conclusion

触觉基础模型为具体感知提供了强有力的表示，但当依赖于传感器的光学、弹性体力学和成像几何形状与预训练期间看到的传感器不同时，它们的性能可能会崩溃。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 BIFTA，这是一种受大脑启发的小样本适应框架，通过双视图统计内存、支持条件谱几何和可靠性门控循环推理，将冻结的触觉编码器传输到未知传感器。三个触觉数据集、两个预训练主干以及分类和排名任务的实验证明了一致的跨传感器增益。在 SITR 上，BIFTA 只需要 10% 的标记目标数据即可将 Sparsh 准确率从 6.86% 提高到 87.09%，比最强的比较高出 47.22 个百分点。消融结果进一步验证了记忆、几何校正和循环证据集成为数据高效适应提供了补充功能。Tactile foundation models provide strong representations for embodied perception, yet their performance can collapse when sensor-dependent optics, elastomer mechanics, and imaging geometry differ from the sensors seen during pretraining. To address this problem, we proposed BIFTA, a brain-inspired few-shot adaptation framework that transfers frozen tactile encoders to unknown sensors through dual-view statistical memory, support-conditioned spectral geometry, and reliability-gated recurrent inference. Experiments across three tactile datasets, two pretrained backbones, and classification and ranking tasks demonstrate consistent cross-sensor gains. On SITR, BIFTA requires only 10% labeled target data to raise Sparsh accuracy from 6.86% to 87.09%, outperforming the strongest comparison by 47.22 percentage points. The ablation results further verify that memory, geometry correction, and recurrent evidence integration provide complementary functions for data-efficient adaptation.

未来的工作将把 BIFTA 扩展到在线机器人操作、视觉触觉材料理解和分布式触觉皮肤感知。我们将通过稀疏邻域和流式更新进一步优化支持条件图构建和循环推理，提高计算效率和对大型查询流的实时适应性。这些进步可以促进与传感器无关的触觉基础模型，并解决实体代理向新部署的异构触觉硬件的快速转移。Future work will extend BIFTA to online robotic manipulation, visual–tactile material understanding, and distributed tactile-skin perception. We will further optimize support-conditioned graph construction and recurrent inference through sparse neighborhoods and streaming updates, improving computational efficiency and real-time adaptability on large query streams. These advances can promote sensor-agnostic tactile foundation models and address the rapid transfer of embodied agents to newly deployed, heterogeneous tactile hardware.

A.1 算法流程Algorithm Procedure

A.2 数据集分割和样本统计Dataset splits and sample accounting

SITR 的原始分类档案包含 7 个传感器的 20 个类别。我们遵循提供的 16 类子集，连续映射到分类器标签空间。这会产生 112,000 张图像：每个传感器 12,800 张训练图像和 3,200 张验证图像。六个目标剧集分别使用 128、640 或 1,280 个支持图像。源为 DIGIT，目标对应于 Mini_1、Mini_2、Mini_3、Mini_4、Hex 和 Wedge。仅训练内部分割与该评估集不同；最终的支持样本是从每类 800 个训练池中抽取的。SITR’s original classification archive contains 20 classes across seven sensors. We follow the supplied 16-class subset, mapped consecutively to the classifier label space. This yields 112,000 images: 12,800 training and 3,200 validation images per sensor. The six target episodes each use 128, 640, or 1,280 support images. The source is DIGIT, and targets correspond to Mini_1, Mini_2, Mini_3, Mini_4, Hex, and Wedge. The train-only inner split is distinct from this evaluation set; the final support sample is drawn from the full 800-per-class training pool.

TacVerse Shape 档案包含 7 个传感器的 30,094 张图像。实验使用源加上正文中指定的五个目标； GelSightMarker 不属于五目标平均值的一部分。九个标签是柱形、长方体、点、边缘、六边形、月亮、环形、三角形和波浪。对于所包含的传感器类对，300/100/100 有序分割会为每个传感器生成 2,700 个训练图像、900 个验证图像和 900 个测试图像。每个目标的支持大小为 27、135 和 270。The TacVerse Shape archive contains 30,094 images across seven sensors. The experiment uses the source plus five targets specified in the main text; GelSightMarker is not part of the five-target average. The nine labels are column, cuboid, dots, edge, hexagon, moon, ring, triangles, and wave. For the included sensor–class pairs, the 300/100/100 ordered split yields 2,700 training images, 900 validation images, and 900 test images per sensor. The support sizes are 27, 135, and 270 per target.

最终的 TacQuad 任务保留了 56 个试验身份，以及所有三个 RGB 传感器的完整 20 帧序列。力场传感器 Tac3D 被排除在 RGB 编码器实验之外。源包含每个身份 12 帧（总共 672 帧）；目标支持包含112/224/336帧，每个目标查询集包含224帧。支持位置和查询位置在采样序列内是不相交的，但它们共享同一性并且可以共享物理试验。The final TacQuad task retains 56 trial identities with complete 20-frame sequences across all three RGB sensors. The force-field sensor Tac3D is excluded from the RGB encoder experiment. The source contains 12 frames per identity (672 total); target support contains 112/224/336 frames, and each target query set contains 224 frames. The support and query positions are disjoint within the sampled sequence, but they share identity and can share a physical trial.

A.3 预处理和特征提取Preprocessing and Feature Extraction

SITR 和 TacVerse 图像转换为 RGB 并调整大小为SITR and TacVerse images are converted to RGB and resized to224×224224\times 224使用 PIL 双三次插值。 TVL使用频道手段with PIL bicubic interpolation. TVL uses channel means(0.291746,0.297133,0.291040)(0.291746,0.297133,0.291040)和标准差and standard deviations(0.187645,0.194677,0.218716)(0.187645,0.194677,0.218716)转换为后after conversion to[0,1][0,1]。 Sparsh 不使用额外的通道归一化，而是将图像与其自身连接以获得六个通道。 TacQuad 使用 torchvision v2 通过双线性插值和抗锯齿调整大小。. Sparsh uses no additional channel normalization and concatenates the image with itself to obtain six channels. TacQuad uses torchvision v2 resizing with bilinear interpolation and antialiasing.

TVL 包装器从已发布的检查点加载触觉编码器状态，并返回全局平均池化和投影特征。第一个读数不是倒数第二个变压器块或 CLS 令牌。对于 Sparsh，包装器均值池对最后两个块中的补丁标记进行归一化，不包括寄存器标记。 TVL 的归档冻结参数计数为 21,961,344，Sparsh 的归档冻结参数计数为 21,894,144。编码器在评估模式下运行，无需梯度更新。The TVL wrapper loads the tactile-encoder state from the released checkpoint and returns global average-pooled and projected features. The first readout is not a penultimate transformer block or a CLS token. For Sparsh, the wrapper mean-pools normalized patch tokens from the final two blocks, excluding register tokens. The archived frozen parameter counts are 21,961,344 for TVL and 21,894,144 for Sparsh. Encoders run in evaluation mode without gradient updates.

Compared with the other methods, BIFTA consistently achieves higher first-rank accuracy and MRR across both backbones and all support budgets, demonstrating stronger cross-sensor identity discrimination.

附录DAppendix D完整的成分证据Complete component evidence

表Table17在 SITR 上报告 11 个 BIFTA 变体的 Macro-F1。谱归一化重塑了标准化的特征几何形状，并持续增强了类别平衡的辨别力，而不确定性门则调节锚点和图证据以减少不可靠的传播。去除光谱归一化会在全模型变体中产生最大的下降；分离门分支表明，分歧与多个设置中的完整门相匹配，而在 5% 预算下，Sparsh 的熵贡献更大。总体而言，完整的框架提供了最强大和最一致的性能模式，表明内存构造、谱几何和可靠性感知推理形成了一个紧密协调的适应过程。reports Macro-F1 for 11 BIFTA variants on SITR. Spectral normalization reshapes the standardized feature geometry and consistently strengthens class-balanced discrimination, while the uncertainty gate regulates anchor and graph evidence to reduce unreliable propagation. Removing spectral normalization produces the largest decline among the full-model variants; separating the gate branches shows that disagreement matches the complete gate in several settings, whereas entropy contributes more strongly with Sparsh at the 5% budget. Overall, the complete framework provides the strongest and most consistent performance pattern, indicating that memory construction, spectral geometry, and reliability-aware inference form a tightly coordinated adaptation process.

附录EAppendix E参数灵敏度Parameter sensitivity

E.1 SITR 的仅训练内部验证Training-only inner validation on SITR

表格Tables18–24使用 5% 的支持预算评估 Mini_3 上的参数敏感性。在一个仅训练传感器上选择参数将配置选择与六传感器评估分开，并提高了实验的公平性。分歧权重和迭代计数在其选定值附近保持相对稳定，而图温度和重复范围则更加敏感，因为它们直接控制边缘集中和重复证据传播的强度。evaluate parameter sensitivity on Mini_3 with a 5% support budget. Selecting parameters on one training-only sensor separates configuration selection from the six-sensor evaluation and improves experimental fairness. The disagreement weight and iteration count remain comparatively stable around their selected values, whereas graph temperature and recurrence range are more sensitive because they directly control edge concentration and the strength of recurrent evidence propagation.

E.2 TacQuad 排名灵敏度TacQuad ranking sensitivity

表格Tables25–29报告 TacQuad 上身份排名的参数敏感性。在默认频谱指数为 0.25 时，频谱归一化在所有六个主干预算设置中将 MRR 提高到了零指数。邻域大小和分歧权重保持相对稳定，而谱指数和递归长度具有更大的影响，因为它们重塑了身份间邻域并调节了排名证据传播的强度；这种影响在最低支持预算下最为明显。report parameter sensitivity for identity ranking on TacQuad. At the default spectral exponent of 0.25, spectral normalization improves MRR over an exponent of zero across all six backbone–budget settings. Neighborhood size and disagreement weight remain comparatively stable, whereas the spectral exponent and recurrence length have larger effects because they reshape inter-identity neighborhoods and regulate how strongly ranking evidence is propagated; this influence is most visible under the lowest support budget.
